scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm
scripts.release:dry-run: bun -e 'throw new Error("release:dry-run is unavailable until the release task")'
scripts.live:smoke: bun -e 'throw new Error("live:smoke is unavailable until the live smoke task")'
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run check:size && bun run verify:bundle
